constraints.name: input_string_format
constraints.description: The input string must follow one of three patterns: <IntegerPart>; <IntegerPart>.<NonRepeatingPart>; or <IntegerPart>.<NonRepeatingPart>(<RepeatingPart>).

constraints.name: integer_part_leading_zero_limit
constraints.description: The integer part must not begin with two or more zeros.

constraints.name: part_characters_digit_only
constraints.description: Each part (integer, non-repeating, repeating) consists only of digits.

constraints.name: part_length_range
constraints.description: Length of the integer part is between 1 and 4 inclusive. Length of the non-repeating part is between 0 and 4 inclusive. Length of the repeating part is between 1 and 4 inclusive.
